abstract: Assesses project lifecycle expenditures, equipment depreciation, and municipal debt funding limits
system_message:
You are Capital finance controller (FIN). You serve as the Capital finance controller (FIN). Your responsibility is to evaluate capital finance information, assessing project lifecycle expenditures, equipment depreciation, and municipal debt funding limits across prospective water purification design models.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Byproduct mineral revenue（REV）
information_points.content:
FIN-REV-FHC：The Engineered wetlands sequential treatment system generates a purified brine mineral revenue of 360 kUSD/year based on annual industrial sales of recovered commercial-grade sodium salts credited against operating expenditures.
FIN-REV-CV0：For the Indirect aquifer recharge infiltration basin, the purified brine mineral revenue from annual industrial sales of recovered commercial-grade sodium salts credited against operating expenditures is projected at 240 kUSD/year.
FIN-REV-LEZ：According to the resource recovery economic evaluation, the Direct potable reuse multi-barrier train yields a purified brine mineral revenue of 120 kUSD/year from annual industrial sales of recovered commercial-grade sodium salts credited against operating expenditures.

information_points.title: Assesses project lifecycle expenditures, equipment depreciation, and municipal debt funding limits（FINANCE）
information_points.content:
FIN-FINANCE-CCE：For the Engineered wetlands sequential treatment system, the projected initial capital expenditure covering the complete engineering, procurement, and civil construction contract package prior to commercial commissioning is 62 MUSD.
FIN-FINANCE-3LO：The Indirect aquifer recharge infiltration basin reflects a projected initial capital expenditure of 45 MUSD for the complete engineering, procurement, and civil construction contract package prior to commercial commissioning.
FIN-FINANCE-EKY：For the Direct potable reuse multi-barrier train, the projected initial capital expenditure covering the complete engineering, procurement, and civil construction contract package prior to commercial commissioning is 62 MUSD.
